audit.source_question:
E B and D C are parallel. Find x.
Choices:

B:6
C:8

audit.independent_solution: Parallel EB and DC imply AE/AD=AB/AC=2/(2+6)=1/4. Since AE=3, AD=12 and DE=9. Thus 2x-3=9 and x=6, option B.
